title: Development, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of Kiosk Management Software for Lighthouse Tourism Project at various Lighthouses
summary: Development, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of kiosk management software for the Lighthouse Tourism Project at various lighthouses, tendered by the Kochi Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kochi

scope.item: Development, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of Kiosk Management Software for Lighthouse Tourism Project

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from nationalised/RBI-approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; small scale industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate exempt.

eligibility: Reputed OEM or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: NIT dated 05.02.2026 (Section 1, pages 3-4). Location given as Deep Bhavan, Cochin; the lighthouses covered are not named. EMD original due 16.02.2026 15:00; bid submission 06.02.2026 11:00 to 17.02.2026 15:00; technical bid opening 18.02.2026 15:00.
